configuration: Gemini-based AiGet prototype with participant-provided profile, focus/familiarity rules, and interaction history; AiGet pipeline in glasses mode, excluding ablation baselines and proposed future features.
sources_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2501.16240v2 — version 2501.16240v2, especially §§5–8 and Appendices B–D

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Interpreted observations are retained across interactions: the context-analysis result is copied into last_ai_response and supplied to context analysis on a subsequent verbal query. This establishes a write path independently of the static participant profile.
S->M.quote: self.last_ai_response["Last Moment's Context Description"] = response_data.get("Context Description")

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Stored suggestions are retrieved by semantic relevance and supplied to knowledge generation; generated items are filtered against this history. The retained profile also conditions content selection and expertise level.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Selected knowledge and its named entities direct a subsequent visual-interpretation request to locate those subjects in the FPV frames and produce bounding boxes. This is an Action-supplied sensing target, even though implemented inside output transformation.
A->S.quote: The Image Reference Agent selects the clearest image covering the mentioned entities from 16 FPV frames and returns their bounding boxes.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: The retained profile is inserted directly into the context-analysis prompt. It guides attention to peripheral entities and interpretation of environmental familiarity; previous context and suggestions also help interpret follow-up questions.
M->S.quote: Predict familiar entities based on user profile, e.g., a Chinese Student may not be familiar with Indian brands.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: The service appends its generated suggestions to interaction history, retains its latest utterance, and logs responses. The suggestion history is subsequently consumed by the generation/filtering pipeline.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The application retains its own suggestions in memory and reuses them on later requests, so the evidence is not limited to researchers' trial logs.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: User dismissal of displayed assistance is obtained by the running application and appended to its timestamped response_log.txt. This establishes outcome retention only, not evaluative use.

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: Dismissals control the current display, but no service-side assessment linking later feedback to the quality or correctness of a particular assistance decision is described; research ratings and pre-delivery candidate scoring do not establish this.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Prompt refinements were authored during pilot design; history accumulation changes content used by fixed prompts and rules, and adaptive interruption rules are proposed future work.
revision.what: No service-authored durable change to model parameters, prompts, reusable rules, skills, code, or harness is stated.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Repeated deployments and history reuse are reported, but no later run under a service-revised mechanism is stated.

notes: Reviewed independently without executing the application or modifying files. All code locators refer to commit 92b17f82a4e54965fc40ce9ea21e919a753ab6b7. The paper's §7.2.4 says real-time gaze/context data are not stored, whereas the listed code retains interpreted context across turns; S->M is grounded narrowly in that explicit code path. The paper specifies Gemini 1.5 Flash/Pro; the checkout has different Gemini defaults (main.py:13; LLMPipeline.py:40).
